title: ReferenceCountryStatusChangedPayload
description: Payload of `reference.country.status_changed` version 1: a country's status or one of its switches changed; the payload carries the whole operating state. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

accepts_orders.description: Whether its service areas accept orders.

accepts_sign_in.description: Whether its customers may sign in.
